SELECT DATE(`paid_at`) AS `stat_date`, SUM(`total_amount` + `freight_amount`) AS `gmv` FROM `trd_order` WHERE `paid_at` >= '2026-02-01' AND `paid_at` < '2026-03-01' AND `order_status` IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY DATE(`paid_at`) ORDER BY `gmv` DESC LIMIT 5;
select `campaign_name`, sum(`spend`) as total_spend from `mkt_ad_spend` where `stat_date` >= '2026-02-01' and `stat_date` < '2026-03-01' group by `campaign_name` order by total_spend desc limit 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_count, SUM(`refund_amount`) AS total_refund_amount FROM `trd_refund` WHERE `refund_status` = 'SUCCESS' AND `refunded_at` >= '2025-02-01' AND `refunded_at` < '2025-03-01';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN `status` = 'USED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS used_coupon_ratio
FROM `mkt_coupon`
WHERE `is_deleted` = 0
  AND `received_at` >= '2026-03-01'
  AND `received_at` < '2026-04-01';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN `device_type` = 'IOS' THEN `pay_amount` ELSE 0 END) AS `ios_pay_amount`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `device_type` = 'ANDROID' THEN `pay_amount` ELSE 0 END) AS `android_pay_amount`
FROM `trd_order`
WHERE `paid_at` IS NOT NULL
  AND `paid_at` >= '2026-03-01'
  AND `paid_at` < '2026-04-01'
  AND `device_type` IN ('IOS', 'ANDROID')

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN `refund_type` = 'REFUND_ONLY' THEN `refund_amount` ELSE 0 END) AS `refund_only_amount`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `refund_type` = 'RETURN_REFUND' THEN `refund_amount` ELSE 0 END) AS `return_refund_amount`
FROM `trd_refund`
WHERE `refund_status` = 'SUCCESS'
  AND `refunded_at` >= '2025-02-01'
  AND `refunded_at` < '2025-03-01';
select `stat_date`, `gmv` from `trd_daily_shop_sales` where `stat_date` >= '2026-03-01' and `stat_date` < '2026-04-01' order by `stat_date`;

select `register_at` as `stat_date`, count(`id`) as `new_member_cnt`
from `usr_member`
where `is_deleted` = 0
and `register_at` >= '2026-02-01'
and `register_at` < '2026-03-01'
group by `register_at`
order by `stat_date`;
SELECT `reason_code`, COUNT(*) AS `refund_count` FROM `trd_refund` WHERE `refund_status` = 'SUCCESS' AND `created_time` >= '2025-02-01' AND `created_time` < '2025-03-01' GROUP BY `reason_code`;

SELECT `s`.`name` AS `shop_name`, SUM(`o`.`pay_amount`) AS `total_pay_amount`
FROM `trd_order` `o`
JOIN `dim_shop` `s` ON `o`.`shop_id` = `s`.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` `r` ON `s`.`region_id` = `r`.`id`
WHERE `o`.`paid_at` >= '2026-03-01' AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2026-04-01'
AND `r`.`big_region` = '华南'
GROUP BY `s`.`id`, `s`.`name`
ORDER BY `total_pay_amount` DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT `carrier`.`name`, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, `order`.`paid_at`, `shipment`.`delivered_at`)) AS `avg_fulfillment_hours`
FROM `tms_shipment` AS `shipment`
JOIN `oms_fulfillment_order` AS `fulfillment` ON `shipment`.`fulfillment_id` = `fulfillment`.`id`
JOIN `trd_order` AS `order` ON `fulfillment`.`order_id` = `order`.`id`
JOIN `tms_carrier` AS `carrier` ON `shipment`.`carrier_id` = `carrier`.`id`
WHERE `order`.`paid_at` >= '2026-03-01' AND `order`.`paid_at` < '2026-04-01'
AND `shipment`.`delivered_at` IS NOT NULL
AND `order`.`paid_at` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `carrier`.`id`, `carrier`.`name`
ORDER BY `avg_fulfillment_hours` DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(`o`.`total_amount` + `o`.`freight_amount`) AS `gmv`
FROM `trd_order` `o`
JOIN `dim_shop` `s` ON `o`.`shop_id` = `s`.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` `r` ON `s`.`region_id` = `r`.`id`
WHERE `o`.`paid_at` >= '2026-02-01'
  AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2026-03-01'
  AND `r`.`big_region` = '华东'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `t1`.`member_id`) AS `buyer_cnt`
FROM `trd_order` `t1`
INNER JOIN `usr_member` `t2` ON `t1`.`member_id` = `t2`.`id`
INNER JOIN `usr_member_level` `t3` ON `t2`.`level_id` = `t3`.`id`
WHERE `t1`.`paid_at` >= '2026-02-01'
  AND `t1`.`paid_at` < '2026-03-01'
  AND `t3`.`name` = '金卡'

SELECT
  `r`.`big_region`,
  SUM(`o`.`pay_amount`) / COUNT(`o`.`id`) AS `atv`
FROM `trd_order` `o`
JOIN `dim_shop` `s` ON `o`.`shop_id` = `s`.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` `r` ON `s`.`region_id` = `r`.`id`
WHERE `o`.`paid_at` >= '2026-02-01'
  AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2026-03-01'
  AND `r`.`big_region` IN ('西南', '东北')
GROUP BY `r`.`big_region`;

SELECT
  DATE(o.`paid_at`) AS `stat_date`,
  SUM(o.`pay_amount`) AS `daily_paid_amount`
FROM `trd_order` o
JOIN `dim_shop` s ON o.`shop_id` = s.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` r ON s.`region_id` = r.`id`
WHERE o.`paid_at` >= '2026-02-01'
  AND o.`paid_at` < '2026-03-01'
  AND r.`big_region` = '华中'
GROUP BY DATE(o.`paid_at`)

select date(`outbound_at`) as `outbound_date`, count(1) as `daily_outbound_count`
from `wms_outbound` o
join `wms_warehouse` w on o.`warehouse_id` = w.`id`
where w.`name` = '华南中心仓'
  and o.`outbound_at` >= '2026-03-01'
  and o.`outbound_at` < '2026-04-01'
group by date(`outbound_at`)
order by `outbound_date`;

select `s`.`name` as `shop_name`, sum(`d`.`order_cnt`) as `total_order_cnt`
from `trd_daily_shop_sales` `d`
join `dim_shop` `s` on `d`.`shop_id` = `s`.`id`
join `dim_platform` `p` on `s`.`platform_id` = `p`.`id`
where `d`.`stat_date` >= '2026-02-01' and `d`.`stat_date` < '2026-03-01'
and `p`.`name` = '天猫'
group by `s`.`name`;

SELECT `s`.`id` AS `shop_id`, `s`.`name` AS `shop_name`, SUM(`r`.`refund_amount`) AS `total_refund_amount`
FROM `trd_refund` `r`
JOIN `trd_order` `o` ON `r`.`order_id` = `o`.`id`
JOIN `dim_shop` `s` ON `o`.`shop_id` = `s`.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` `reg` ON `s`.`region_id` = `reg`.`id`
WHERE `r`.`refund_status` = 'SUCCESS'
  AND `r`.`refunded_at` >= '2026-02-01'
  AND `r`.`refunded_at` < '2026-03-01'
  AND `reg`.`big_region` = '华东'
GROUP BY `s`.`id`, `s`.`name`;

select distinct `wms_warehouse`.`name`
from `wms_stockout_record`
inner join `wms_warehouse` on `wms_stockout_record`.`warehouse_id` = `wms_warehouse`.`id`
where `wms_stockout_record`.`created_time` >= '2026-02-01'
  and `wms_stockout_record`.`created_time` < '2026-03-01'
  and `wms_stockout_record`.`is_deleted` = 0
  and `wms_warehouse`.`is_deleted` = 0;

select `sku_id`, count(distinct `order_id`) as `refund_order_count`
from `trd_refund` r
join `trd_aftersale_reason` rsn on r.`reason_code` = rsn.`code`
where rsn.`code` = 'STOCKOUT'
and r.`refund_status` = 'SUCCESS'
and r.`created_time` >= '2026-02-01'
and r.`created_time` < '2026-03-01'
group by `sku_id`
order by `refund_order_count` desc
limit 3;

select `sku_id`, count(distinct `order_id`) as `refund_order_count`
from `trd_refund` r
join `trd_aftersale_reason` rsn on r.`reason_code` = rsn.`code`
join `trd_refund_item` ri on r.`id` = ri.`refund_id`
where rsn.`code` = 'STOCKOUT'
and r.`refund_status` = 'SUCCESS'
and r.`created_time` >= '2026-02-01'
and r.`created_time` < '2026-03-01'
group by `sku_id`
order by `refund_order_count` desc
limit 3;

select count(*) as `outbound_count` from `wms_outbound` o join `wms_warehouse` w on o.`warehouse_id` = w.`id` where w.`name` = '华东中心仓' and o.`outbound_at` >= '2026-02-01' and o.`outbound_at` < '2026-03-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `outbound_count`
FROM `wms_outbound` o
JOIN `wms_warehouse` w ON o.`warehouse_id` = w.`id`
WHERE w.`name` = '华南中心仓'
  AND o.`outbound_at` >= '2026-02-01'
  AND o.`outbound_at` < '2026-03-01'
select sum(`total_amount` + `freight_amount`) as `gmv` from `trd_order` where `paid_at` >= '2026-03-01' and `paid_at` < '2026-04-01'

SELECT
  `year_month`,
  SUM(`gmv`) AS `gmv`
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(`o`.`paid_at`, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`,
    SUM(`o`.`total_amount` + `o`.`freight_amount`) AS `gmv`
  FROM `trd_order` `o`
  WHERE `o`.`is_deleted` = 0
    AND `o`.`paid_at` IS NOT NULL
    AND (`o`.`paid_at` >= '2026-03-01' AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2026-04-01'
         OR `o`.`paid_at` >= '2025-03-01' AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2025-04-01')
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(`o`.`paid_at`, '%Y-%m')
) `t`
GROUP BY `year_month`
ORDER BY `year_month`;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `id`) AS `订单数` FROM `trd_order` WHERE `paid_at` IS NOT NULL AND `device_type` = 'IOS' AND `paid_at` >= '2026-03-01' AND `paid_at` < '2026-04-01';

SELECT
  `device_type`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `id`) AS `order_cnt`
FROM `trd_order`
WHERE `paid_at` IS NOT NULL
  AND `created_at` >= '2026-03-01'
  AND `created_at` < '2026-04-01'
  AND `device_type` IN ('IOS', 'ANDROID')
GROUP BY `device_type`;

SELECT
    c1.`name` AS `一级类目名称`,
    SUM(oi.`pay_share`) AS `销售额`
FROM
    `trd_order_item` oi
JOIN
    `trd_order` o ON oi.`order_id` = o.`id`
JOIN
    `prd_category` c3 ON oi.`category_id` = c3.`id`
JOIN
    `prd_category` c2 ON c3.`parent_id` = c2.`id`
JOIN
    `prd_category` c1 ON c2.`parent_id` = c1.`id`
WHERE
    o.`paid_at` >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.`paid_at` < '2026-01-01'
    AND o.`order_status` NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')
    AND c1.`level` = 1
    AND c1.`name` = '服饰鞋包'
GROUP BY
    c1.`name`

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(`o`.`paid_at`, '%Y-%m') AS `month`,
  SUM(`oi`.`pay_share`) AS `sales_amount`
FROM `trd_order` `o`
JOIN `trd_order_item` `oi` ON `o`.`id` = `oi`.`order_id`
JOIN `prd_category` `c3` ON `oi`.`category_id` = `c3`.`id`
JOIN `prd_category` `c2` ON `c3`.`parent_id` = `c2`.`id`
JOIN `prd_category` `c1` ON `c2`.`parent_id` = `c1`.`id`
WHERE `o`.`paid_at` >= '2025-01-01'
  AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2026-01-01'
  AND `o`.`order_status` NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')
  AND `c1`.`name` = '服饰鞋包'
GROUP BY `month`
ORDER BY `month`;
